title: antennaria friesiana subsp. compacta
intro: Antennaria friesiana subsp. compacta, commonly known as Woolly Yarrow, is a subspecies of the flowering plant species Antennaria friesiana, native to the mountainous regions of North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Antennaria friesiana subsp. compacta include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which may help in treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
